relationships.subject: CB2
relationships.evidence_quote: CB2 activation causes a downregulation of transient receptor potential vanilloid 1 receptors (TRPV1) in the spinal cord and DRG of rats with CCI.

relationships.subject: AM1241
relationships.evidence_quote: AM1241 reduced mRNA levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines that are elevated in response to CFA such as tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF- α), interleukin-1 beta (IL-1β) and interleukin-6 (IL-6) in rats.

key_findings: Review: CB2 agonists suppress inflammatory and neuropathic pain behaviours in rodents, but ligand bias, off-target actions (CB1, opioid) and route of administration confound mechanism; conditional KO mice implicate CB2 in sensory neurons and myeloid cells.
